text:
emma-dev: @krish-support customer reported duplicate charge after our Python SDK retried an order-create request. They saw the order twice (created twice) even though app code only called create once. Using python-sdk v0.9.3.
krish-support: can you paste minimal repro and any headers? specifically need to know if an Idempotency-Key was set by the app or by the SDK.
emma-dev: snippet from user (sanitized):

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=...)  # default client
resp = client.orders.create({"sku": "gold", "qty": 1})
```

No explicit Idempotency-Key in app. They rely on SDK auto-idempotency/retries. Logs show initial request timed out (socket timeout) but server created resource. SDK retried and got 201 again => duplicate.
sam-sre: this is consistent with a retry/idempotency mismatch. If SDK generates an Idempotency-Key only on the first attempt but fails to attach the same key to subsequent retries (or regenerates a new key on retry), server will create again. Also possible that 429/503 handling path isn't preserving headers.
lina-eng: confirmed a regression introduced in 0.9.3 where the prepared request object is cloned without copying the custom idempotency header when jitter_backoff is used. Fix is in PR #3445 (persist idempotency key in RetryContext and reuse it for all attempts). Will add unit and integration tests against 429/503 sequences.
krish-support: repro steps for SRE/QA:
1) run a local proxy that returns 503 for first request but still creates resource on backend (simulate server-side creation then 503).
2) call the SDK without app-provided Idempotency-Key.
3) observe two creations when SDK retries.
Example curl to simulate (backend creates, proxy bangs):
```bash
# backend: responds 201 but proxy returns 503 to client on first attempt
# then allow subsequent requests to reach backend
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -X POST https://proxy.local/orders -d '{"sku":"gold"}'
```

emma-dev: any immediate workarounds to give the customer?
lina-eng: two short-term options:
- set explicit Idempotency-Key in app: client.orders.create(..., headers={"Idempotency-Key": "<uuid>"})
- disable automatic retries by setting retry=None or REDWOOD_DISABLE_AUTO_RETRY=true and implement manual retry with preserved idempotency keys
sam-sre: recommend telling customer to pin to v0.9.2 for now if they need auto-retry behavior, and apply manual idempotency as Lina suggested. We'll cut a quick patch release (0.9.4) with the fix and a regression test.
emma-dev: can you share ETA for 0.9.4? customer is on live checkout flows.
lina-eng: PR opened, review + CI green. Hoping to merge in next 2-3 hours, then patch release and canary deploy same day. I'll post the release notes and the exact commit.
deploy-bot: :rocket: deploy initiated for release/0.9.4 -> canary
krish-support: I'll update the customer with the workaround and ETA. Logging this as escalation. Tagging eng-runtime for monitoring.
sam-sre: followup: add e2e test that simulates half-acks (server processed but client sees network error). Also add logging we can surface in Console: show Idempotency-Key used per attempt in trace view (redact full key in UI).
emma-dev: thanks all. I'll send the customer's repro case + request ID. :eyes:
